query: SELECT r.name, p.name, rp.effect FROM roles r LEFT JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id=r.id LEFT JOIN permissions p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE r.id = ANY($1) ORDER BY r.name, p.name
UPDATE outbox_events SET state='dispatched', dispatched_at=$2, attempts=attempts+1 WHERE seq=$1
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM role_assignments ra JOIN roles r ON r.id=ra.role_id WHERE ra.membership_id=$1 AND r.is_owner_role AND (ra.expires_at IS NULL OR ra.expires_at > $2))
